performance.sharpe_basis: PRIMARY = daily-aggregated Sharpe = (mean(daily_net_return)/stdev(daily_net_return)) * sqrt(252) computed over 30 UTC trading days. The earlier 'holding-time aware' figure (sqrt(30240) factor, -114.4836) is preserved as a HEURISTIC because 77.75% of adjacent trades have overlapping holding windows (the engine re-enters before the prior trade exits), violating the i.i.d./non-overlapping assumption that factor relies on; daily aggregation internalizes that overlap. The per-minute diagnostic (-396.5829) further over-annualizes 12-min holds and is for sanity only. All three figures agree directionally; daily is the methodologically clean headline.

top_critical_issues: BacktestEngine simulates synthetic order book from candles instead of consuming real bookDepth.csv

verdict.recommended_action: Re-run on ≥7d overlap data and wire real book features into BacktestEngine

phase_5d_multi_resolution.reason: run_backtest_multi_resolution iterates the engine across 1m/5m/15m on 39,695 1m bars and exceeded the audit time budget on this 31-day window. Phase 5C single-resolution backtest provides the primary engine assessment; Phase 5D was previously validated on the 8h-overlap audit run and that prior result is NOT carried into the verdict here.
